title: LLM-Finetuned Merger Arbitrage Outcome Forecaster — H310 Revival
description: H310 NOT CONFIRMED (2026-06-25): MNA/MRGR ETF merger arbitrage failed because ETFs cannot discriminate deal-break risk. The paper arXiv:2607.09921 bypasses ETFs entirely, using a finetuned LLM to directly forecast individual M&A deal outcomes (close at announced terms / higher bid / deal termination) from hundreds of pages of deal documents. The finetuned system achieves class-balanced Brier score 0.151 on 400+ large global deals — 24% better than calibrated market-implied probabilities, 19% better than XGBoost, and 25-42% better than frontier LLMs. The key innovation: hindsight-guided reasoning traces (finetuning on 'what happened and why' in resolved deals) combined with expert-designed context engineering. H465 design: (1) Build deal dataset from SEC 14D-9/SC TO merger filings via EDGAR for 2015-2025 US announced deals; (2) Use GPT-4o-mini (zero-shot) or finetuned Llama-3-8B as deal outcome forecaster; (3) When LLM probability of 'close at announced terms' > 0.75, enter long target / short acquirer synthetic spread trade; (4) Size positions by Kelly fraction of edge over market-implied spread. Gate: OOS Sharpe > 1.678 (MRGR ETF OOS Sharpe that passed Sharpe gate but failed WF gate in H310) AND WF ratio 0.75-2.5 (no regime artifact). IS: 2015-2021, OOS: 2022-2025. Primary limitation: requires meaningful deal corpus and GPT-4o-mini API calls per deal ($0.10-0.50/deal). Also requires M&A deal database (Bloomberg SDC Platinum is gold standard but expensive; SEC EDGAR has 14D-9 filings as free alternative). Note: The paper tests on large global deals (>$1B enterprise value) — liquidity is better for spread trades on these names.
content:
# H465 — LLM-Finetuned Merger Arbitrage Outcome Forecaster

## Source
arXiv:2607.09921 (Jajal et al., Jul 2026) 'Global Merger-Arbitrage Forecasting with Language Models'

## Key Paper Findings
- Finetuned LLM on hindsight-guided reasoning traces outperforms all methods
- Class-balanced Brier score 0.151 (vs 0.199 market-implied, 0.187 XGBoost)
- 24% better than calibrated market-implied probabilities
- 400+ large deals spanning 42 countries — diverse corpus
- Three outcome classes: close at terms / higher bid / deal termination
- Key success factors: long-context reasoning over full merger docs + hindsight supervision

## Connection to H310
H310 NOT CONFIRMED because MNA/MRGR ETFs cannot discriminate deal-break risk within their universe. This hypothesis bypasses ETFs and targets individual deal-level prediction. The LLM's ability to reason over legal documents and regulatory risk is the core alpha source.

## H465 Design
1. M&A deal universe: US deals $500M+ enterprise value from EDGAR 14D-9/SC TO filings (2015-2025)
2. LLM scorer: GPT-4o-mini zero-shot on deal prospectus summary (Phase 1); finetuned on resolved deals (Phase 2)
3. Entry: when P(close_at_terms) > 0.75, enter long target stock
4. Sizing: Kelly fraction based on spread width × P(close) - loss × P(termination)
5. Exit: deal resolution or 180-day stop

## Variants
- A: GPT-4o-mini zero-shot, P(close)>0.75 long
- B: XGBoost on deal characteristics (deal size, premium, all-cash vs all-stock, industry)
- C: Market-implied spread (Brier comparison baseline)
- D: GPT-4o-mini + Kelly sizing
- E: Termination probability signal (long premium when P(term)>0.5 pre-termination)

## Gate
- OOS Sharpe > 1.678 (MRGR OOS from H310, regime-adjusted)
- WF ratio 0.75-2.5 (not regime-artifact driven)
- MaxDD < -20%

## IS/OOS Split
- IS: 2015-2021
- OOS: 2022-2025

## Cost
- GPT-4o-mini: ~$0.10-0.50/deal × ~50 deals/year = $5-25/year
- EDGAR filings: free (SEC EDGAR EFTS search API)

## Script
backtesting/daily/run_h465_llm_merger_arb.py

## CAUTION
- US equity merger arb is dominated by hedge funds with Bloomberg SDC data; free EDGAR proxy may miss private/foreign deals
- Deal corpus from EDGAR 14D-9 covers target-side only; acquirer intentions are in SC TO (Tender Offer)
- Spread trading requires borrowing target stock pre-announcement (difficult for retail); paper account only tests directional long
